mentions.name: CribScore
mentions.description: A cribbage scoring cheat sheet website providing a quick reference for scoring cribbage hands, built as a learning aid for people picking up the game.
mentions.problem: The family was learning cribbage and couldn't find a great cribbage scoring cheat sheet online.
mentions.audience: My family and other people learning to play cribbage who need help scoring hands.
mentions.source_excerpt: Learning cribbage, my family has been learning cribbage and we are leaning hard on cribbage scoring cheat sheets, but haven't found a great one online. So I put together https://cribscore.linsomniac.com/
